_readFirst: T12 (TS, desktop/src/main/doc-comments/xlsx-comments.ts) and T18 (Kotlin, XlsxComments.kt, not built in this session) both parse an xlsx app-level thread id with the SAME pre-written regex (docs/active/specs/2026-09-26-doc-comments-build-design.md §4.2, design review round 2 F2): /^xt-(\d+)-([^-]+)-(.+)$/ — group 1 is sheetId (parsed as an integer), group 2 is the cell reference (never itself contains a hyphen), group 3 is the GUID VERBATIM (braces already stripped by whoever minted the id; never re-split on its own internal hyphens even though it contains four of them). Both runtimes read this file directly in their own pinning tests so a fix to one parser that the other doesn't share fails immediately, instead of silently diverging.

vectors.case: worked example from the design doc itself (uppercase GUID, Mac-Excel convention)
lowercase GUID — real Google Sheets export convention (§4.2 guidFormat)
three-letter, seven-digit cell — Excel's own maximum address (XFD1048576)
